detailed_description: The Percentage Stacked Bar Chart Generator creates 100% stacked bar charts from editable categories and series values. Each row represents one category, and each series value is treated as a percentage segment, so the chart is best when every row adds up to 100%. You can rename series, add or remove series, add or remove category rows, edit values inline, choose a color theme, show or hide the legend, switch between vertical and horizontal layout, load sample device-usage data, and export the chart as PNG or SVG. This is useful for comparing composition across groups, such as channel mix by quarter, survey responses by audience, or device share by year. The tool does not import CSV, normalize raw values automatically, generate embed code, or store charts on a backend.
usage_steps: Load the sample data or start editing the default rows.
Rename each series to match the segments you want to compare.
Edit each category row and enter percentage values for every series.
Add rows or series if your chart needs more categories or segments.
Choose a color theme and toggle the horizontal layout or legend.
Download the finished chart as PNG or SVG.
usage_examples: Compare mobile, tablet, and desktop traffic share across several years.
Show survey answer percentages for different customer segments.
Visualize sales channel contribution by quarter when each row totals 100%.
Export a PNG for a report or an SVG for a presentation deck.

faqs.question: Does the tool normalize raw values automatically?
faqs.answer: No. Enter percentage values directly and keep each category row close to 100% for a correct 100% stacked chart.

faqs.question: Can I add more than three series?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can add series up to the limit in the interface and rename each one.

faqs.question: Can I switch chart orientation?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Horizontal option switches between vertical stacked columns and horizontal stacked bars.

faqs.question: Which export formats are available?
faqs.answer: The chart can be downloaded as PNG or SVG.
